Name: Angelstep
Description: Herb with medicinal or magical properties. Can be gathered in wilderness and prepared for use.

Name: Black Amaranth
Description: Valuable herb with potent properties. Requires skill to gather and prepare properly.

Name: Bloody Mandrake
Description: Root herb with distinctive appearance. Used in various preparations.

Name: Bone Reed
Description: Reed-like plant found in specific terrain. Valuable for its properties when prepared.

Name: Cloud Puff
Description: Fungus or plant with cloud-like appearance. Requires careful preparation.

Name: Desna's Star
Description: Inexpensive herb, possibly associated with Desna, goddess of dreams and stars. Common and easily gathered.

Name: Dragon Rose
Description: Rose variety with draconic associations. Moderately valuable herb.

Name: Dream Lichen
Description: Extremely rare and valuable lichen with dream-related properties. Most expensive herb. Likely affects sleep, dreams, or consciousness.

Name: Fairy Cap
Description: Mushroom with fey associations. Expensive and rare. May have magical or supernatural properties.

Name: Goblinvine
Description: Vine plant, possibly named for goblin habitats or uses. Moderately priced herb.

Name: Leechwort
Description: Very cheap herb, possibly used for drawing out toxins or healing wounds. Second-cheapest herb.

Name: Love-In-Idleness
Description: Herb from folklore, possibly affecting emotions or charm. Named after Shakespeare's flower used for love potions.

Name: Merfolk's Comb
Description: Aquatic plant or seaweed associated with merfolk. Expensive, likely found in water or coastal areas.

Name: Mimameith
Description: Rare herb with significant value. Properties unknown but expensive enough to be potent.

Name: Moly
Description: Legendary herb from Greek mythology that protects against magic. Second most expensive herb. In myth, given by Hermes to Odysseus to resist Circe's magic.

Name: Nepenthe
Description: Herb that removes pain and sorrow. Named after mythological drug that banishes grief. Likely provides relief from mental or emotional afflictions.

Name: Nethys's Dagger
Description: Herb associated with Nethys, god of magic. Possibly shaped like a dagger or used in magical preparations.

Name: Nightsage
Description: Sage variety that grows or is harvested at night. Moderately expensive, likely has nocturnal or shadow-related properties.

Name: Seeing Slime
Description: Fungus or mold that grants vision-related benefits. Possibly provides darkvision, detection abilities, or scrying properties.

Name: Winterbite
Description: Cold-weather herb with biting properties. Inexpensive, possibly provides cold resistance or is used in cold climates.
